label: preserve
contract: Asking get_page for a page after the last one returns an empty list.
visible_check:
from pages import get_page
assert get_page(list(range(8)), 5, 4) == [], get_page(list(range(8)), 5, 4)
heldout_check:
from pages import get_page
assert get_page(tuple(range(25)), 4, 10) == []
assert get_page("abc", 9, 2) == []

label: arbitrary
contract: Page numbers start at 1, so page 1 holds the first per_page items.
visible_check:
from pages import get_page
assert get_page(list(range(10)), 2, 4) == [4, 5, 6, 7], get_page(list(range(10)), 2, 4)
heldout_check:
from pages import get_page
assert get_page(list("abcdefg"), 1, 3) == ["a", "b", "c"]
assert get_page(list("abcdefg"), 3, 3) == ["g"]

label: arbitrary
contract: get_page raises ValueError for a page number below 1.

label: inferable
contract: page_count counts a final partly filled page as a page.
visible_check:
from pages import page_count
assert page_count(7, 3) == 3, page_count(7, 3)
assert page_count(9, 3) == 3, page_count(9, 3)
heldout_check:
from pages import page_count
assert page_count(25, 10) == 3
assert page_count(30, 10) == 3
assert page_count(101, 50) == 3

label: arbitrary
contract: page_count returns 1 when there are no items, because an empty listing still shows one empty page.
visible_check:
from pages import page_count
assert page_count(0, 3) == 1, page_count(0, 3)
heldout_check:
from pages import page_count
assert page_count(0, 10) == 1
assert page_count(0, 1) == 1

label: arbitrary
contract: Both functions raise ValueError when per_page is less than 1.
